findings.description: The San Francisco Planning Commission is set to meet to discuss conditional use permits for the GLIDE Foundation's proposed seven-story social services building at 334 Ellis Street, replacing a surface parking lot and connecting to GLIDE's existing facility next door at 330 Ellis Street. SF YIMBY first reported the project in March 2022; it has since been revised down in scale, most recently in September 2025. The new building would add 45,760 square feet to GLIDE's existing 36,540 square feet of social-services space across the two buildings. Heller Manus Architects designed the project; GLIDE Foundation, a nonprofit, is self-sponsoring it. The work is proposed, not built, so nothing goes into the building block of a page that does not exist yet.

findings.description: New building permits have been filed for a three-story residential infill at 720 Masonic Avenue in NoPa, approved by the Planning Department in mid-July 2026. Xie Associates designed the project on behalf of the property owner. The roughly 31-foot-tall building would yield about 4,400 square feet: two four-bedroom apartments and a two-bedroom accessory dwelling unit. It replaces a lot left vacant after the previous house was gutted by fire in 2023 and demolished in 2024; the property last sold in 2023 for $1.35 million. The work is proposed, not built, so nothing goes into the building block of a page that does not exist yet.
